text: …ここで　いってても　しゃーない　まずは　ニシキに　あいに　いこか！

structure.en: even if we keep talking here

structure.jp: ニシキに　あいに　いこか！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after a て-form means 'even if'. Here いってて is a shortened いっていて, 'be saying'. いってても = 'even if we go on talking'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after a verb with its ます cut off, followed by a verb of going, says what you go to do. あいに　いこ = 'let's go to meet'.

patterns.name: 〜ようか
patterns.explanation: いこか is the Kansai dialect short form of いこうか, a 'shall we' suggestion. いこか = 'shall we go'.
